name: Infinite Tiling with Modulo
definition: A single mod call on the ray position before evaluating the SDF tiles a scene infinitely at essentially zero extra cost, enabling ray-marched fractal renderers like Mandelbulbs and Menger sponges.
summary: Infinite Tiling with Modulo renders infinite repeating patterns by folding space via the modulo operator, differing from constructive modeling by transforming coordinates to create periodicity.
